theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_compact_lusin_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → Measurable u → ∀ E : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet E → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ E) → ∃ C : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ W ∩ E ∧ c < μ C ∧ ContinuousOn u C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
